user.description:
SailCast turns wind, wave, tide and weather forecasts into safety ratings and sailing windows for your spots, boats and sailors.

**SailCast is advisory.** Official forecasts and warnings come first, and the skipper always decides.

After setup, add your spots, boats and sailors from this integration's page.

data_description.name: For example, Harbor or Lake.
data_description.location: Drop the pin on the water where you sail. The circle sets the area the wind map shows.
data_description.offshore: Wind from these directions blows away from the shore.
data_description.exposed: Directions with open water, where waves can build.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.description: SailCast suggests the nearest sources. Tide and current predictions come from NOAA and warnings from the National Weather Service, so for now they cover US waters only.

data_description.tide_station: For tide heights, highs and lows.
data_description.current_station: For the wind-against-current rule. Pick one only if it's close to where you sail.
data_description.marine_zone: Official warnings, such as a Small Craft Advisory, come from this zone.

error.name_taken: Another spot already has this name.
error.radius_out_of_range: Make the circle's radius between 2 and 50 km (about 1 to 30 miles).
error.suggestions_unavailable: Couldn't look up nearby sources. You can save without them and add them later by editing the spot.

data_description.name: For example, the boat's name.
data_description.size_class: Each size has its own safety limits for wind, gusts and waves.

error.length_out_of_range: Enter a length between 1 and 50 m (3 and 164 ft).

data_description.skill: Each sailor rates their own skill. It sets their limit for sustained wind; gusts don't count toward it.
data_description.default_boat: SailCast rates this boat unless the sailor picks another.
data_description.other_boats: Other boats this sailor takes out.
data_description.start: Leave empty to start at sunrise.
data_description.end: Leave empty to finish at sunset.
data_description.user: The panel opens on this sailor for them.

comfort.name: Comfort
comfort.description: What this sailor enjoys. These change scores, never a safety rating.

data_description.ideal_low: Narrows the ideal wind for each of their boats. Leave empty to use the boat's range.
data_description.ideal_high: Leave empty to use the boat's range, up to the skill limit.
data_description.coldest: Scores drop in colder air. Leave empty for 50 °F (10 °C).

auto_calendar.name: Automatic calendar
auto_calendar.description: Add this sailor's best window each chosen day to a calendar, at most one event a day. SailCast keeps the event in step with the forecast until 6 PM the evening before, then warns instead of moving it.

data_description.calendar: Leave empty to turn automatic adding off. Local Calendar, Google Calendar and CalDAV calendars accept new events.
data_description.ahead: Forecasts change most beyond three days.
data_description.auto_spots: When windows at different spots overlap, SailCast adds only the best one.
